question: Do the inherited Kummer classes share quadric total spaces and ruling fields, and do their ruling lines give the same quadratic base change?
selection: The twenty retained anchor basis points and the three previously frozen CT chain classes.
checks: Verify the coefficient-quadric determinant identity B*Norm(beta).
Construct both lines through each anchor point over Q(sqrt(B)) and exact sections over their quadratic parameter maps.
Identify each finite branch value with the reciprocal x-coordinate of P plus or minus (0,sqrt(B)).
Check distinct branch values, nonsingularity of those fibres, and non-invariance of the displayed section.
Keep shared total-space solubility separate from the known CT-obstructed fibres.
checkpoint: One immutable per-anchor checkpoint; compact final report with pinned hashes and exact rational-pair coordinates.
oracle_boundary: Anchor points define these retrospective constructions. No resulting branch-value feature is a prospective selector.
failure_semantics: Coincidence is a candidate common base change, not automatically independent rational points over Q. Distinctness excludes only these ruling-line constructions.
